posts.title: IKEv1 protocol disabled in strongSwan package for Debian unstable
posts.description: Heads up, Debian IKE/IPsec users. Starting with strongSwan 6.1.0-1 (currently in Debian unstable and targeted at Debian 14 Forky), the IKEv1 protocol has been disabled. This is aligned with upstream decision .
